name: vidaxl_dropshipping-mcp
display_name: vidaXL B2B dropshipping (dropshippingxl.com offline → b2b.vidaxl.com) MCP
description: vidaXL B2B dropshipping (dropshippingxl.com offline → b2b.vidaxl.com) (ecommerce suppliers): me, lis

platform_mcp_vidaxl_dropshipping_email.title: PLATFORM_MCP_VIDAXL_DROPSHIPPING_EMAIL
platform_mcp_vidaxl_dropshipping_email.description: The vidaXL B2B customer e-mail (HTTP Basic username).

platform_mcp_vidaxl_dropshipping_api_tok.title: PLATFORM_MCP_VIDAXL_DROPSHIPPING_API_TOKEN
platform_mcp_vidaxl_dropshipping_api_tok.description: API token shown under MY ACCOUNT on b2b.vidaxl.com (HTTP Basic password). Sandbox tokens belong to https://sandbox.b2b.vidaxl.com, which this server does not switch to.

tools.name: me
tools.description: vidaXL has no account endpoint; the probe reads one product with the Basic credentials, so `account` is empty on success. Limit 1 request/second.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: GET /api_customer/products?limit&offset: the products you may sell [{id, name, code (SKU), category_path, quantity, price, created_at, updated_at}] (up to 500 per request). quantity and price are decimal strings (list_price, quantity). `query` and `category` are not accepted. `id` is the SKU code used in orders.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: GET /api_customer/products?code_eq={SKU}: a one-element array; an unknown SKU is an empty array (invalid_input). Images, descriptions and full prices are in the offer feed, not the API.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: POST /api_customer/orders. 'Order payment is not available via API. All the accepted orders are available in Unsubmitted orders' and must be paid on b2b.vidaxl.com. `shipping_address` is the addressbook {name, address (max 30 chars, with a number), address2, city, province (required for US/AU), postal_code, country (ISO-2), phone, comments}; `items` are order_products [{product_code, quantity}] (an item may carry its own addressbook). customer_order_reference is a fresh UUID. `shipping_option` is not sent.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: GET /api_customer/orders?id_eq={id}: [{order: {id, status_order_id, status_order_name (Temporary, Submitted, Being Prepared, Sent, Cancelled, Refunded, Replaced), submitted_at, gross_total, shipping_tracking, shipping_tracking_url, order_products}}]; tracking number and URL appear at status 5 (Sent). Totals are decimal strings.
